description: Limite Domaine Public Fluvial-Mer is a dataset listed in data.gouv.nc open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Gouvernement de la Nouvelle-Calédonie. Le domaine de la Nouvelle-Calédonie comprend « sous réserve des droits des tiers et sauf lorsqu'ils sont situés dans les terres coutumières, les cours d'eau, lacs, eaux souterraines et sources » (loi organique modifiée n°99-209 du 29 mars 1999, art. 22-31° et art. 99-7°). Coverage: New Caledonia. The portal files it under Environment, Climate. Its keywords are DPF, Domaines Public Fluvial, fluviaux, Embouchures, Limites, Mers. The portal shows 2020-11-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support inland waterway and lock studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-gouv-nc-portal.
